- [LFST.7.6.4] A subsequent `CacheGet` is **not** recorded — it is a
  pure internal read of the engine's own cache,
  re-derived on replay, where the rules that wrote
  the cache fire again on the recorded inputs. No store is
  shared between engines ([LSTO.4.7.3]), so no read has a
  value from outside the engine to record.
